Module dev.metaschema.schemagen

Package dev.metaschema.schemagen

package dev.metaschema.schemagen
Provides schema generation capabilities for Metaschema modules.

This package contains the core API and implementations for generating XML Schema (XSD) and JSON Schema from Metaschema module definitions. The main entry point is ISchemaGenerator, which provides methods to generate schemas in different formats.

Key classes:

  • ISchemaGenerator - Main interface for schema generation
  • IGenerationState - Manages state during schema generation
  • IInlineStrategy - Controls definition inlining behavior
  • ModuleIndex - Indexes definitions across modules
